snippet.title: PREQUEL - Gameplay Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Build, destroy, explore, discover, face countless foes and play as them through possession in the crazy and oddly beautiful Abyss of PREQUEL.

TYCLOPUS's PREQUEL coming soon on Kickstarter.

Follow us on:

https://twitter.com/prequel_tco

Join PREQUEL Discord:

Discover more:

Music by Mario Busto Calderón
